headline: Türkiye Completes EU Machinery Safety Harmonization for Exports
summary: Türkiye completed its alignment with the European Union's machinery safety legislation to fulfill customs union requirements, targeting up to $450 billion in total exports by 2029.
why: Harmonizing industrial standards with the EU is crucial for Turkish manufacturers to maintain seamless access to their largest export market.

impacts.name: Turkish Industrial Manufacturing
impacts.why: Adopting EU machinery safety rules removes trade friction and supports export growth toward EU markets.
